questions.q: In a fit-gap session, what happens when a process owner confirms that standard Oracle functionality satisfies a requirement?
options: It is marked a Fit and moves to the configuration workbook
It is automatically escalated to an extension gap
It is removed from the Requirements Traceability Matrix
It requires a Service Request to Oracle Support
questions.explain: When standard functionality satisfies a requirement as-is, it is marked a Fit and moves directly to the configuration workbook.

questions.q: Which type of gap requires the business process itself to change, often making it the hardest to close?
options: Configuration gap
Extension gap
Process gap
Security gap
questions.explain: A process gap means Oracle's standard process is capable, but the business process needs to change — requiring organizational change management, not just configuration.

questions.q: Why does TCM's "adopt, not adapt" principle push teams to avoid extension gaps when possible?
options: Extensions are always cheaper than configuration
Extensions carry ongoing cost: they must be re-tested each quarterly update and don't automatically gain new features
Extensions are not allowed by Oracle under any circumstance
Extensions replace the need for a Solution Architect
questions.explain: Extensions carry ongoing maintenance cost because they must be re-tested with every quarterly update and don't automatically benefit from new standard functionality.

options: A requirement with no proposed solution
A requirement found only during User Acceptance Testing
A requirement that can only be solved by changing the chart of accounts
A requirement closeable through a non-default setup choice, with no code required
questions.explain: A configuration gap can be resolved through standard functionality using a non-default setup choice, without any code or extension.

questions.q: How did Brightfield's wire-matching requirement get classified?
options: Entirely as a process gap requiring Treasury to change its procedures
Mostly as a configuration gap, with one piece split out as an extension gap
Entirely as a fit with no changes needed
As out of scope for Phase 1
questions.explain: Oracle's reconciliation matching rules, configured correctly, automated most of the manual process (a configuration gap), while a legacy report format requirement became a separate extension gap.
